items.title: Lee Paige Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: Yes. Yeah, I know Ethel Waters... Back in 1918... she was doing coon shouting for this Black Bird Recording Company. >> [INTERVIEWER] Black Swan, I believe. [INTERVIEWEE] No, Black Bird.

ctx.x: Yes. Yeah, I know Ethel Waters and, you know, Ethel Waters has been around quite a long time. She used to do some coon shouting too, you know. Back in 1918, when she recorded the song in 1918, there'll be some changes made on Black Bird Recording Company. In 1918, she was doing coon shouting for this Black Bird Recording Company. What was that?
No, Black Bird. Black Bird? Black Bird Recording Company.
